clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within eighteen months: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents' distance from each other by November as your father worked late most nights, your stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah's shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September 1996; these shifts pile up across the family around the new baby, with your mother's functioning down at the end of the period.
